subject: Amendment to the Schedule on who may act as members of the Specific Claims Tribunal
precis: Amendment to the Schedule of Order in Council P.C. 2010-1467 of November 25, 2010, as amended by Order in Council P.C. 2011-1714 of December 20, 2011, as amended by Order in Council P.C. 2016-359 of May 18, 2016, as amended by Order in Council P.C. 2019-900 of June 22, 2019, as amended by Order in Council P.C. 2021-286 of April 13, 2021, as amended by Order in Council P.C. 2022-378 of April 19, 2022, as amended by Order in Council P.C. 2022-0554 of May 26, 2022, by adding the name of the The Honourable Tracy Engelking to the roster of superior court judges who may act as members of the Specific Claims Tribunal.
